providers_services.doc_id: Firestore auto id assigned by the admin/provider app; the doc id is duplicated in the `id` field (web reads by doc(id) and by where('id','==',x) interchangeably).

id.shape: same as doc id; also used with '!=' in related-services query

price.shape: numeric stored as string, always parseFloat()'d

disPrice.shape: discount price as string; '0' or '' means no discount

photos.shape: array<string> image URLs; photos[0] is the thumbnail

latitude.shape: used for client-side zone check getUserZoneId(lat,lng)

g.shape: GeoFirestore v4: {geohash:string, geopoint:geopoint}; implicitly range-queried/ordered by .near()

coordinates.shape: GeoFirestore v4 coordinates key (survives into provider_orders.provider embed)

startTime.shape: 'HH:mm' opening time (string compare against current time)

reviewsCount.shape: may be missing/''/NaN on old docs

order_by.where: layouts/footer.blade.php:336-343 subscription item-limit check (where author== orderBy createdAt asc limit(itemLimit), then startAfter(lastDoc))

providers_services.pagination: limit(pagesize) home; limit(200) popular; limit(4) related; limit(itemLimit)+startAfter in footer subscription check
providers_services.geo_usage: geoFirestore.collection('providers_services').near({center: GeoPoint(address_lat,address_lng), radius: VendorNearBy km}).where('sectionId','==').where('publish','==') [+ where categoryId/author] — home_page/ondemand_home.blade.php:487, providersService/servicesList.blade.php:164. Results are then filtered client-side by zone (latitude/longitude) and provider subscription validity.
providers_services.writes: Mostly read-only from web (created by admin/provider panel). Exception: customer review flow updates aggregate rating: my_booking/completed_booking.blade.php:768 update({reviewsCount, reviewsSum}).
providers_services.access: public-read for publish==true. Writes must be server-side only; the reviewsCount/reviewsSum update must move to a server endpoint that recomputes from the reviews table (items_review) instead of trusting browser math.
providers_services.notes: price/disPrice are strings. reviewsCount/reviewsSum can be missing/''/NaN (code guards with isNaN). startTime/endTime are 'HH:mm' strings, not timestamps (name clash with provider_orders.startTime which IS a timestamp). Geo docs need both g{geohash,geopoint} and coordinates; MySQL should store lat/lng (DECIMAL) + optional geohash index and drop g/coordinates. Full doc is embedded (denormalized) into provider_orders.provider at checkout. 'Invalid' services (provider subscription expired / over itemLimit) are computed client-side in footer.blade.php:300-360 from users.subscription_plan.itemLimit, subscriptionTotalOrders, subscriptionExpiryDate.

provider_orders.doc_id: client-generated Firestore auto id: database.collection('tmp').doc().id (20 chars) — ondemand_checkout.blade.php:342 and providersService/success.blade.php:59; written with doc(id).set() and duplicated in field `id`.

address.shape: {address:string|null, addressAs:string|null, id:string|null, isDefault:bool|null, landmark:string|null, locality:string, location:{latitude:float, longitude:float}} — copy of one users.shippingAddress[] entry, or cookie fallback (address_name/address_lat/address_lng) with nulls

adminCommission.shape: numeric string from hidden input #adminCommission (section default or provider override)

author.shape: full snapshot of customer users doc (firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, profilePictureURL, id, fcmToken, shippingAddress[], wallet_amount, ...). Direct checkout deletes g/createdAt/coordinates; gateway success path embeds it unmodified. Queried on author.id (footer onSnapshot).

extraCharges.shape: '' at create; provider app sets numeric (string) extra charge during 'Order Ongoing'

extraPaymentStatus.shape: true at create in direct checkout (missing in gateway success path); set true after extra-charge / service-charge payment

newScheduleDateTime.shape: null at create; rescheduled time set by provider app

paymentStatus.shape: false for Hourly services (paid later), true for fixed price at create

provider.shape: full providers_services doc snapshot minus g/createdAt: {id, author, authorName, title, description, price:string, disPrice:string, priceUnit, photos[], address, latitude, longitude, coordinates:geopoint, categoryId, subCategoryId, sectionId, publish, days[], startTime, endTime, reviewsCount, reviewsSum}

reason.shape: null at create; cancellation reason typed by customer

scheduleDateTime.shape: booking date/time chosen by customer (JS Date)

status.shape: 'Order Placed'|'Order Accepted'|'Order Assigned'|'Order Ongoing'|'Order Completed'|'Order Cancelled'|'Order Rejected' (filtered client-side, never in where())

taxSetting.shape: array<{country:string, enable:bool, id:string, tax:string|number, title:string, type:'fix'|'percentage'}> copied from tax collection

workerId.shape: '' at create; FK providers_workers.id assigned by provider

startTime.shape: READ-ONLY on web: set by provider/worker app when job starts

endTime.shape: READ-ONLY on web: set by provider/worker app when job ends; null check used in footer notifications

provider_orders.realtime: onSnapshot on where('author.id','==',cuser_id) in layouts/footer.blade.php:1851 — listens for 'modified' changes to status/extraCharges/endTime to show notifications. Needs a polling or push replacement.
provider_orders.writes: CLIENT CREATES AND UPDATES. Create: set() at providersService/ondemand_checkout.blade.php:2173 (cod/wallet) and providersService/success.blade.php:173 (after gateway redirect; order_json comes from server session but was originally posted by browser). Updates: cancel {reason, status:'Order Cancelled'} at my_booking/pending_booking.blade.php:527, accepted_booking.blade.php:557, ongoing_booking.blade.php:623; payment {paymentStatus, payment_method, couponCode, discount, discountLabel, discountType, extraPaymentStatus} at providersService/service_charge/pay_service_charge.blade.php:1997 and service_charge/success.blade.php:115; {extraPaymentStatus:true} at extra_charge/pay_extra_charge.blade.php:1557 and extra_charge/success.blade.php:84. Side effects done in browser alongside: users.wallet_amount debit/credit and wallet docs (customer + provider + admin commission).
provider_orders.access: owner (authorID) for read + cancel; provider (provider.author) and assigned worker (workerId) need read/update from their apps. All money fields and paymentStatus/extraPaymentStatus must be set server-side only.
provider_orders.security: HIGH: browser sets paymentStatus=true, extraPaymentStatus=true, discount, adminCommission, payment_method and wallet balances directly (wallet path checks balance only in JS). Coupon validity/amount is computed in browser and posted to apply-service-coupon. OTP is generated client-side. Cancel from client triggers client-side wallet refunds (updateUserWallet/updateProviderWallet). Payment gateway secrets (razorpaySecret, orangepay_clientSecret, ...) are read from settings into hidden inputs and posted back by the browser.
provider_orders.notes: Numeric money fields are strings (discount, discountLabel, adminCommission, provider.price/disPrice, extraCharges). author/provider are full denormalized snapshots — in MySQL keep author_id/service_id FKs plus a JSON snapshot column if historical display is required. extraPaymentStatus absent on gateway-created orders. startTime/endTime/newScheduleDateTime/workerId are populated by other apps (provider/worker), never by web. adminCommissionType casing inconsistent ('percentage' vs 'fixed'/'Fixed'). status is a free string.

providers_workers.doc_id: id field equals doc id (doc(workerId).update and where('id','==',workerId) both used); created by provider app/admin.
providers_workers.writes: Read-only except rating aggregate: my_booking/completed_booking.blade.php:741 update({reviewsCount, reviewsSum}).
providers_workers.access: mixed: public-read of display fields (name, photo, phone, email shown to the customer whose booking the worker is assigned to — ideally restrict contact fields to that customer). Rating update must be server-side.
providers_workers.notes: Web only reads display/contact fields; the provider/worker app almost certainly stores more (providerId/author, fcmToken, active, location, password/auth fields, sectionId) — confirm against admin panel before final migration. Email/phone exposure to any logged-in user (where id==) is a privacy concern.

provider_categories.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; id field mirrors doc id (doc(id).get() used).
provider_categories.writes: read-only from web (data comes from an admin panel we must build).
provider_categories.notes: No parent link is read on web; sub-categories presumably carry a parent id (e.g. parentCategoryId) in the admin data — add a nullable parent_id column. level is compared to number 0 so must be numeric.

providers_coupons.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id (coupondata.id posted as coupon_id).

discount.shape: number or numeric string (parseFloat'd); face value

providerId.shape: FK users.id (provider); coupon only valid for that provider's services

order_by.where: home_page/ondemand_home.blade.php:125 (startAt(new Date()).limit(4)); offers/offers.blade.php:37 (startAt + limit(10) + startAfter pagination); ondemand_checkout.blade.php:541; service_charge/pay_service_charge.blade.php:475

providers_coupons.pagination: limit(4) home; limit(10)+startAfter on offers page
providers_coupons.access: public-read for isEnabled && isPublic && expiresAt>now; non-public coupons must be validated server-side by code (never listed).
providers_coupons.security: Coupon validation is client-side: pay_service_charge.blade.php:557 looks up by sectionId+code only (no isEnabled/expiresAt check) and the browser posts discount/discountType to the server (apply-service-coupon / apply-service-charge-coupon). Server must re-validate code, expiry, enabled, providerId and compute the discount.
providers_coupons.notes: vendorID is read on offers page for the generic coupons collection only (not this one). discountType vocabulary inconsistent ('Percentage' vs 'Percent'). No usage-limit / per-user fields are read on web.

parcel_orders.doc_id: PHP uniqid() rendered into the page (13 hex chars, e.g. '66f1c2a9b3e4d') — parcel/parcel_checkout.blade.php:412 and parcel/success.blade.php:48; doc(id).set(), also stored in `id`.

author.shape: full customer users doc snapshot (incl. g/coordinates/createdAt — nothing stripped). Queried on author.id; reads author.firstName, author.profilePictureURL

createdAt.shape: browser new Date() in direct checkout; serverTimestamp() in gateway success path

discount.shape: discount amount string ('0' when none), number_format()ted by PHP

distance.shape: km as string (server-computed route distance, round-tripped via hidden input)

status.shape: 'Order Placed'|'Order Accepted'|'Driver Pending'|'Driver Accepted'|'Order Shipped'|'In Transit'|'Order Completed'|'Order Cancelled'|'Driver Rejected'|'Order Rejected'

subTotal.shape: round(km * delivery_charge) computed in ParcelController, round-tripped as string

parcelImages.shape: array<string> Firebase Storage URLs uploaded from browser

taxSetting.shape: array<{country, enable:bool, id, tax, title, type}>

driverId.shape: null at create; set by driver app

driver.shape: READ-ONLY on web, set by driver app: users snapshot {id, firstName, lastName, email, profilePictureURL, ...}

rejectedByDrivers.shape: null at create; array<string driverId> maintained by driver app/dispatcher

sourcePoint.shape: {geohash:string(9), geopoint:geopoint} of sender — used by driver app geo dispatch

reviewsCount.shape: written by customer review flow on the ORDER doc

vendorID.shape: READ but NEVER WRITTEN (dead copy-paste from food orders, parcel_orders.blade.php:260)

parcel_orders.realtime: onSnapshot where('author.id','==',cuser_id) at layouts/footer.blade.php:1911 for status-change notifications.
parcel_orders.geo_usage: No GeoFirestore near() on web, but each order stores sourcePoint/destinationPoint {geohash, geopoint} (GeoFirestore-style) for driver-side proximity dispatch; store lat/lng + geohash columns.
parcel_orders.writes: CLIENT CREATES: set() at parcel/parcel_checkout.blade.php:1554 (cod/wallet/receiver-pays) and parcel/success.blade.php:132 (after gateway). CLIENT UPDATES: {reviewsCount, reviewsSum} at parcel/parcel_orders.blade.php:796 and :854. Same pages also write users.wallet_amount, wallet, users(driver).reviewsCount/Sum and items_review from the browser.
parcel_orders.access: owner (authorID) read; driver (driverId) read/update status from driver app; all creation should go through a server endpoint.
parcel_orders.security: HIGH: entire order incl. subTotal, discount, adminCommission, payment_method is assembled in the browser from hidden inputs; wallet deduction done client-side (balance check only in JS); paymentCollectByReceiver chosen by browser. Coupon lookup by code doesn't check sectionId. parcelImages uploaded straight to Firebase Storage from browser.
parcel_orders.notes: Two creation paths produce slightly different docs: success.blade.php path gets lat/lng as STRINGS into GeoPoint (may throw) and uses serverTimestamp, checkout path uses browser Date. parcelWeight stores the weight NAME, not the parcel_weight id (senderParcelWeight id is dropped). Field naming inconsistent: parcelCategoryID vs sectionId vs senderZoneId; note vs receiverNote. Numbers stored as strings (distance, subTotal, parcelWeightCharge, discount, adminCommission). driver map/driverId/rejectedByDrivers come from driver app.

parcel_coupons.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id.

isPublic.shape: probably present in admin data but NOT filtered on web for parcel coupons

parcel_coupons.security: Apply-by-code (parcel_checkout.blade.php:683) filters code+isEnabled+expiresAt but NOT sectionId; discount/discountType/coupon_id posted from browser to apply_parcel_coupon — server must recompute.
parcel_coupons.notes: Offers page does not filter by sectionId for parcel coupons; checkout list filters sectionId+expiresAt and checks isEnabled client-side. isPublic is not used here (unlike providers_coupons).

parcel_categories.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id (where('id','==',id)).
parcel_categories.notes: parcel_orders.blade.php:153 builds a ref to the whole collection but never uses it. Title is copied into parcel_orders.parcelType.

parcel_weight.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id.

parcel_weight.writes: read-only from web (admin panel). Whole collection fetched unfiltered (parcel/parcel.blade.php:292).
parcel_weight.security: delivery_charge is put in an <option delivery_charge=...> attribute and POSTed back to parcel_cart; ParcelController trusts the posted rate — server must look up the rate by weight id.
parcel_weight.notes: No sectionId / publish / sort field read; list order is Firestore default (doc id). Consider adding sort_order and active columns.

taxSetting.shape: array<{country, enable:bool, id, tax, title, type}>

reviewsCount.shape: written by customer review flow on the ORDER doc

rental_orders.geo_usage: No near() on web; stores sourcePoint {geohash, geopoint} for driver-side dispatch.
rental_orders.writes: CLIENT CREATES: set() at rental/rental_checkout.blade.php:430. CLIENT UPDATES: {paymentMethod, paymentStatus:true} at rental/rental_orders_detail.blade.php:1232 (wallet) and :1264 (cod/other) and rental/success.blade.php:59 (after gateway); {status:'Order Cancelled'} at rental/rental_orders.blade.php:949; {reviewsCount, reviewsSum} at rental_orders.blade.php:279/:334 and rental_orders_detail.blade.php:824/:879.
rental_orders.access: owner (authorID) read + cancel (only while 'Order Placed'); driver (driverId) updates trip fields from driver app; payment and amounts server-only.
rental_orders.security: CRITICAL: browser sets paymentStatus=true directly (rental_orders_detail.blade.php:1264 for non-wallet/non-gateway methods marks paid with no payment at all). Final trip total (extra km / extra minute fares, tax, discount) is computed in browser (rental_orders_detail.blade.php:553-666) and used for wallet debit. Cancel has no status guard. Package/vehicle data posted back from browser to find_rental_cars and embedded verbatim — a user can tamper baseFare/extra fares.
rental_orders.notes: Uses paymentMethod (camelCase) whereas provider/parcel orders use payment_method. vehicleId holds a vehicle TYPE id. 'Kito' typo in odometer keys. Embedded rentalPackageModel/rentalVehicleType numeric values are strings after the session round-trip. rentalVehicleType.description is read but home page lists short_description — both may exist. No drop-off location stored despite isDropSameLocation UI.

rental_coupons.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id.

isPublic.shape: likely present in admin data; not filtered on web

rental_coupons.security: Apply-by-code (rental_checkout.blade.php:268) ignores sectionId; browser posts discount/discountType/coupon_id to apply_rental_coupon — server must re-validate and compute.
rental_coupons.notes: Same shape as parcel_coupons. Offers page does not filter by sectionId.

rental_vehicle_type.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id.

rental_packages.doc_id: admin-assigned auto id; `id` field mirrors doc id.

rental_packages.writes: read-only from web (admin panel). Whole doc embedded in rental_orders.rentalPackageModel.
rental_packages.security: baseFare and fares go browser -> find_rental_cars -> session -> order; server must re-read package by id.
rental_packages.notes: Uses `published` while sibling collections use `publish`/`isActive`. No sectionId/zone field read (scoped via vehicleTypeId). Any extra admin-side fields flow into orders via the embed.
